definitions.gloss: having many difficulties ahead; a rough road ahead
definitions.explanation: Describes a situation where many obstacles and troubles are expected in the future.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいプロジェクトは{前途多難|ぜんとたなん}だ。
examples.english: The new project has a rough road ahead.

examples.japanese: {前途多難|ぜんとたなん}な{状況|じょうきょう}だが、{諦|あきら}めない。
examples.english: It's a difficult situation ahead, but I won't give up.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}{状況|じょうきょう}を{見|み}ると、{前途多難|ぜんとたなん}と{言|い}わざるを{得|え}ない。
examples.english: Looking at the economic situation, one can only say that there are many difficulties ahead.

notes:
YOJIJUKUGO ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}): This is a four-character compound idiom.

CHARACTER BREAKDOWN:
・{前|ぜん} - before, ahead
・{途|と} - road, way
・{多|た} - many
・{難|なん} - difficulty, hardship

ANTONYM:
・{前途洋洋|ぜんとようよう} (bright future ahead)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{多事多難|たじたなん} (full of troubles and difficulties)
・{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう} (stormy, eventful life)
・{難航|なんこう}する (to make slow progress due to difficulties)

USAGE PATTERN:
・{前途多難|ぜんとたなん}な〜 (a ~ with difficulties ahead)
・{前途多難|ぜんとたなん}を{予想|よそう}する (to anticipate difficulties ahead)
